Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. The search query included the phrase "ove their performance as a consultant," which was a snippet from an arXiv paper about an AI model (RAFT). The WebSurfer incorrectly extracted this snippet as evidence linking a person named "Eenasul Fateh" (stage name Aladin) to being a consultant who helps organizations improve performance. This was a hallucination/misinterpretation of unrelated text. The subsequent steps were based on this false lead, leading the entire investigation down the wrong path. The agent should have recognized that the snippet was from a computer science paper about generative models and had no relation to a human consultant named Aladin.
